name: Fables
description: A dynamic-fee ve(3,3) DEX built on Uniswap v4. Each pool charges a fee tuned to its asset — calendar-based for tokenised stocks, volatility-based for crypto — so LPs are paid more when a trade is more likely to be against them.
methodology: Enumerates every Fables pool from the on-chain FablesPoolRegistry (activePools) and sums each v4 pool's token reserves, reconstructed from its tick liquidity via Uniswap v4 StateView.
